subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: Should OpenClaw make OpenRouter text model discovery a provider-owned live catalog/list feature, a generic OpenAI-compatible dynamic catalog seam, or keep runtime-only dynamic resolution plus documented provider wildcards?
rationale: The remaining choice affects provider API contracts, config semantics, model selection UX, offline caching, and safety/cost policy, which source inspection alone cannot resolve.

options.title: OpenRouter provider-owned live catalog first
options.body: Implement OpenRouter text catalog/list discovery inside the OpenRouter plugin using existing catalog SDK patterns, then generalize only after the UX and safety semantics are proven.

options.title: Generic cross-provider catalog seam
options.body: Design a broader OpenAI-compatible dynamic catalog contract before provider-specific work, accepting slower delivery for a cleaner long-term API.

options.title: Document runtime plus wildcards only
options.body: Declare provider/* and runtime dynamic resolution the supported surface for now and close broader default list/picker discovery as out of scope.

recommendation.title: OpenRouter provider-owned live catalog first
recommendation.body: Implement OpenRouter text catalog/list discovery inside the OpenRouter plugin using existing catalog SDK patterns, then generalize only after the UX and safety semantics are proven.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent source-history and review-routing signal across OpenRouter runtime hooks and live provider catalog policy.
